title: Matter is anything that takes up space and has mass
summary: Matter is anything that takes up space and has mass, and a gas counts, because a balloon swells when gas is put in.
body: OpenStax Chemistry says matter is anything that occupies space and has mass. Solids and liquids make that easy to see, because they take room and they have weight. A gas is matter too. If a gas took no room, a balloon would stay flat instead of puffing up when it is filled. The page is a textbook definition. It does not name a particular gas, and it does not weigh the balloon.
